(* --- 1.1 Hydrostatic Depth Pressure 2oo3 Voter (Nominal ~ 400.0 bar at 4000m Depth) --- *)
(* Channel discrepancy tolerances: 6.0 bar allowable spread between independent transmitters *)
bPressTMR_ChA_Healthy := (ABS(rDepthPressure_ChA_bar - rDepthPressure_ChB_bar) <= 6.0) OR (ABS(rDepthPressure_ChA_bar - rDepthPressure_ChC_bar) <= 6.0);
bPressTMR_ChB_Healthy := (ABS(rDepthPressure_ChB_bar - rDepthPressure_ChA_bar) <= 6.0) OR (ABS(rDepthPressure_ChB_bar - rDepthPressure_ChC_bar) <= 6.0);
bPressTMR_ChC_Healthy := (ABS(rDepthPressure_ChC_bar - rDepthPressure_ChA_bar) <= 6.0) OR (ABS(rDepthPressure_ChC_bar - rDepthPressure_ChB_bar) <= 6.0);

IF bPressTMR_ChA_Healthy AND bPressTMR_ChB_Healthy AND bPressTMR_ChC_Healthy THEN
    (* All 3 Channels Healthy: Median Selection Algorithm *)
    IF ((rDepthPressure_ChA_bar >= rDepthPressure_ChB_bar) AND (rDepthPressure_ChA_bar <= rDepthPressure_ChC_bar)) OR
       ((rDepthPressure_ChA_bar >= rDepthPressure_ChC_bar) AND (rDepthPressure_ChA_bar <= rDepthPressure_ChB_bar)) THEN
        rVotedDepthPressure_bar := rDepthPressure_ChA_bar;
    ELSIF ((rDepthPressure_ChB_bar >= rDepthPressure_ChA_bar) AND (rDepthPressure_ChB_bar <= rDepthPressure_ChC_bar)) OR
          ((rDepthPressure_ChB_bar >= rDepthPressure_ChC_bar) AND (rDepthPressure_ChB_bar <= rDepthPressure_ChA_bar)) THEN
        rVotedDepthPressure_bar := rDepthPressure_ChB_bar;
    ELSE
        rVotedDepthPressure_bar := rDepthPressure_ChC_bar;
    END_IF;
    iPressTMR_DegradedState := 0; (* Nominal 2oo3 *)
ELSIF bPressTMR_ChA_Healthy AND bPressTMR_ChB_Healthy THEN
    rVotedDepthPressure_bar := (rDepthPressure_ChA_bar + rDepthPressure_ChB_bar) * 0.5;
    iPressTMR_DegradedState := 1; (* Degraded 2oo2: Channel C Fault *)
    dwAlarmTreeLowSeverity := dwAlarmTreeLowSeverity OR 16#00000001; (* Warning: Pressure Ch C Fault *)
ELSIF bPressTMR_ChA_Healthy AND bPressTMR_ChC_Healthy THEN
    rVotedDepthPressure_bar := (rDepthPressure_ChA_bar + rDepthPressure_ChC_bar) * 0.5;
    iPressTMR_DegradedState := 1; (* Degraded 2oo2: Channel B Fault *)
    dwAlarmTreeLowSeverity := dwAlarmTreeLowSeverity OR 16#00000002; (* Warning: Pressure Ch B Fault *)
ELSIF bPressTMR_ChB_Healthy AND bPressTMR_ChC_Healthy THEN
    rVotedDepthPressure_bar := (rDepthPressure_ChB_bar + rDepthPressure_ChC_bar) * 0.5;
    iPressTMR_DegradedState := 1; (* Degraded 2oo2: Channel A Fault *)
    dwAlarmTreeLowSeverity := dwAlarmTreeLowSeverity OR 16#00000004; (* Warning: Pressure Ch A Fault *)
ELSIF bPressTMR_ChA_Healthy THEN
    rVotedDepthPressure_bar := rDepthPressure_ChA_bar;
    iPressTMR_DegradedState := 2; (* Degraded 1oo1: Only Ch A Remaining *)
    dwAlarmTreeLowSeverity := dwAlarmTreeLowSeverity OR 16#00000008;
ELSE
    (* All Pressure Transmitters Discrepant - Critical TMR Failure *)
    iPressTMR_DegradedState := 3;
    dwAlarmTreeHighSeverity := dwAlarmTreeHighSeverity OR 16#00000001; (* Critical: Total Depth Pressure Loss *)
END_IF;

(* --- 1.2 Umbilical Tension 2oo3 Voter (Nominal Range 10.0..150.0 kN) --- *)
bTensionTMR_ChA_Healthy := (ABS(rUmbilicalTension_ChA_kN - rUmbilicalTension_ChB_kN) <= 15.0) OR (ABS(rUmbilicalTension_ChA_kN - rUmbilicalTension_ChC_kN) <= 15.0);
bTensionTMR_ChB_Healthy := (ABS(rUmbilicalTension_ChB_kN - rUmbilicalTension_ChA_kN) <= 15.0) OR (ABS(rUmbilicalTension_ChB_kN - rUmbilicalTension_ChC_kN) <= 15.0);
bTensionTMR_ChC_Healthy := (ABS(rUmbilicalTension_ChC_kN - rUmbilicalTension_ChA_kN) <= 15.0) OR (ABS(rUmbilicalTension_ChC_kN - rUmbilicalTension_ChB_kN) <= 15.0);

IF bTensionTMR_ChA_Healthy AND bTensionTMR_ChB_Healthy AND bTensionTMR_ChC_Healthy THEN
    IF ((rUmbilicalTension_ChA_kN >= rUmbilicalTension_ChB_kN) AND (rUmbilicalTension_ChA_kN <= rUmbilicalTension_ChC_kN)) OR
       ((rUmbilicalTension_ChA_kN >= rUmbilicalTension_ChC_kN) AND (rUmbilicalTension_ChA_kN <= rUmbilicalTension_ChB_kN)) THEN
        rVotedUmbilicalTension_kN := rUmbilicalTension_ChA_kN;
    ELSIF ((rUmbilicalTension_ChB_kN >= rUmbilicalTension_ChA_kN) AND (rUmbilicalTension_ChB_kN <= rUmbilicalTension_ChC_kN)) OR
          ((rUmbilicalTension_ChB_kN >= rUmbilicalTension_ChC_kN) AND (rUmbilicalTension_ChB_kN <= rUmbilicalTension_ChA_kN)) THEN
        rVotedUmbilicalTension_kN := rUmbilicalTension_ChB_kN;
    ELSE
        rVotedUmbilicalTension_kN := rUmbilicalTension_ChC_kN;
    END_IF;
    iTensionTMR_DegradedState := 0;
ELSIF bTensionTMR_ChA_Healthy AND bTensionTMR_ChB_Healthy THEN
    rVotedUmbilicalTension_kN := (rUmbilicalTension_ChA_kN + rUmbilicalTension_ChB_kN) * 0.5;
    iTensionTMR_DegradedState := 1;
    dwAlarmTreeLowSeverity := dwAlarmTreeLowSeverity OR 16#00000010;
ELSIF bTensionTMR_ChA_Healthy AND bTensionTMR_ChC_Healthy THEN
    rVotedUmbilicalTension_kN := (rUmbilicalTension_ChA_kN + rUmbilicalTension_ChC_kN) * 0.5;
    iTensionTMR_DegradedState := 1;
    dwAlarmTreeLowSeverity := dwAlarmTreeLowSeverity OR 16#00000020;
ELSIF bTensionTMR_ChB_Healthy AND bTensionTMR_ChC_Healthy THEN
    rVotedUmbilicalTension_kN := (rUmbilicalTension_ChB_kN + rUmbilicalTension_ChC_kN) * 0.5;
    iTensionTMR_DegradedState := 1;
    dwAlarmTreeLowSeverity := dwAlarmTreeLowSeverity OR 16#00000040;
ELSE
    rVotedUmbilicalTension_kN := 45.0; (* Default conservative assumption *)
    iTensionTMR_DegradedState := 3;
    dwAlarmTreeHighSeverity := dwAlarmTreeHighSeverity OR 16#00000002; (* Critical: Total Tension Sensor Loss *)
END_IF;

(* --- 1.3 Doppler Velocity Log (DVL) Bottom-Track Surge & Sway 2oo3 Voter --- *)
bDVLTMR_ChA_Healthy := (ABS(rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChA_mps - rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChB_mps) <= 0.08) OR (ABS(rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChA_mps - rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChC_mps) <= 0.08);
bDVLTMR_ChB_Healthy := (ABS(rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChB_mps - rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChA_mps) <= 0.08) OR (ABS(rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChB_mps - rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChC_mps) <= 0.08);
bDVLTMR_ChC_Healthy := (ABS(rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChC_mps - rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChA_mps) <= 0.08) OR (ABS(rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChC_mps - rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChB_mps) <= 0.08);

IF bDVLTMR_ChA_Healthy AND bDVLTMR_ChB_Healthy AND bDVLTMR_ChC_Healthy THEN
    (* Surge Median *)
    IF ((rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChA_mps >= rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChB_mps) AND (rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChA_mps <= rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChC_mps)) OR
       ((rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChA_mps >= rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChC_mps) AND (rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChA_mps <= rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChB_mps)) THEN
        rVotedSurgeVel_mps := rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChA_mps;
    ELSIF ((rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChB_mps >= rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChA_mps) AND (rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChB_mps <= rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChC_mps)) OR
          ((rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChB_mps >= rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChC_mps) AND (rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChB_mps <= rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChA_mps)) THEN
        rVotedSurgeVel_mps := rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChB_mps;
    ELSE
        rVotedSurgeVel_mps := rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChC_mps;
    END_IF;
    (* Sway Median *)
    IF ((rDVL_Velocity_Sway_ChA_mps >= rDVL_Velocity_Sway_ChB_mps) AND (rDVL_Velocity_Sway_ChA_mps <= rDVL_Velocity_Sway_ChC_mps)) OR
       ((rDVL_Velocity_Sway_ChA_mps >= rDVL_Velocity_Sway_ChC_mps) AND (rDVL_Velocity_Sway_ChA_mps <= rDVL_Velocity_Sway_ChB_mps)) THEN
        rVotedSwayVel_mps := rDVL_Velocity_Sway_ChA_mps;
    ELSIF ((rDVL_Velocity_Sway_ChB_mps >= rDVL_Velocity_Sway_ChA_mps) AND (rDVL_Velocity_Sway_ChB_mps <= rDVL_Velocity_Sway_ChC_mps)) OR
          ((rDVL_Velocity_Sway_ChB_mps >= rDVL_Velocity_Sway_ChC_mps) AND (rDVL_Velocity_Sway_ChB_mps <= rDVL_Velocity_Sway_ChA_mps)) THEN
        rVotedSwayVel_mps := rDVL_Velocity_Sway_ChB_mps;
    ELSE
        rVotedSwayVel_mps := rDVL_Velocity_Sway_ChC_mps;
    END_IF;
    iDVLTMR_DegradedState := 0;
ELSIF bDVLTMR_ChA_Healthy AND bDVLTMR_ChB_Healthy THEN
    rVotedSurgeVel_mps := (rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChA_mps + rDVL_Velocity_Surge_ChB_mps) * 0.5;
    rVotedSwayVel_mps := (rDVL_Velocity_Sway_ChA_mps + rDVL_Velocity_Sway_ChB_mps) * 0.5;
    iDVLTMR_DegradedState := 1;
    dwAlarmTreeLowSeverity := dwAlarmTreeLowSeverity OR 16#00000100;
ELSE
    (* DVL Acoustic Lock Lost (e.g. dense nepheloid sediment plume) *)
    rVotedSurgeVel_mps := rSurgeVelocityTarget_mps * (1.0 - (rTractionSlipRatio_Port + rTractionSlipRatio_Stbd) * 0.5);
    rVotedSwayVel_mps := 0.0;
    iDVLTMR_DegradedState := 2;
    dwAlarmTreeLowSeverity := dwAlarmTreeLowSeverity OR 16#00000200; (* Warning: DVL Plume Lock Lost *)
END_IF;

(* Determine overall degraded control status *)
bDegradedControlActive := (iPressTMR_DegradedState > 0) OR (iTensionTMR_DegradedState > 0) OR (iDVLTMR_DegradedState > 0) OR bManualDegradedOverride;

(* ==================================================================================================
   STAGE 2: ACOUSTIC RESONANT FLUIDIZED BED DYNAMICS & PHASE-LOCKED LOOP (PLL)
   ================================================================================================== *)
(* Multi-phase Archimedes Number Ar = (d_p^3 * rho_f * (rho_p - rho_f) * g) / mu_f^2 *)
rArchimedesNumber := (EXPT(rNoduleMeanDiameter_m, 3.0) * rSeawaterDensity_kg_m3 * (rNoduleDensity_kg_m3 - rSeawaterDensity_kg_m3) * 9.81) / EXPT(rSeawaterViscosity_Pa_s, 2.0);

(* Ergun Equation quadratic solution for minimum fluidization Reynolds number: *)
(* 1.75 / (eps^3 * phi_s) * Re_mf^2 + 150*(1-eps)/(eps^3 * phi_s^2) * Re_mf - Ar = 0 *)
(* Assuming sphericity phi_s = 0.86 for nodule morphology *)
rReynoldsNumber_mf := (-124.5 + SQRT(15500.25 + 4.0 * 2.36 * rArchimedesNumber)) / (2.0 * 2.36);
IF rReynoldsNumber_mf < 0.1 THEN
    rReynoldsNumber_mf := 0.1;
END_IF;
rMinimumFluidizationVel_mps := (rReynoldsNumber_mf * rSeawaterViscosity_Pa_s) / (rSeawaterDensity_kg_m3 * rNoduleMeanDiameter_m);

(* Resonant Acoustic Radiation Force: F_rad = - grad <U> approx = (V_p * 2 * pi * f / c_0) * I_ac * F_factor *)
rAcousticLevitationPower_kW := (EXPT(rAcousticGeneratorPWM_Duty * 0.01 * 600.0, 2.0) / (rAcousticImpedance_Ohm * 1000.0)) * COS(rAcousticPhase_deg * 0.0174533);
IF rAcousticLevitationPower_kW < 0.0 THEN
    rAcousticLevitationPower_kW := 0.0;
END_IF;
rAcousticRadiationForce_N := (rAcousticLevitationPower_kW * 1000.0 / 1485.0) * 1.85; (* Hydroacoustic coupling *)

(* PLL Phase Locked Loop Tracking Engine *)
rPLL_PhaseError_deg := rAcousticPhase_deg - 0.0; (* Target phase = 0.0 deg for electrical series resonance *)
IF bAcousticFluidizerEnable AND (iCurrentStateID = 50) THEN
    (* Active Phase-Locked Closed Loop *)
    rPLL_Integrator := rPLL_Integrator - (rPLL_PhaseError_deg * rPLL_Ki * rCycleTime_s);
    (* Bound integrator within piezo composite bandwidth: 18.000 to 28.500 kHz *)
    IF rPLL_Integrator > 28.500 THEN
        rPLL_Integrator := 28.500;
    ELSIF rPLL_Integrator < 18.000 THEN
        rPLL_Integrator := 18.000;
    END_IF;
    rAcousticExcitationFreq_kHz := rPLL_Integrator - (rPLL_PhaseError_deg * rPLL_Kp);
    IF rAcousticExcitationFreq_kHz > 28.500 THEN
        rAcousticExcitationFreq_kHz := 28.500;
    ELSIF rAcousticExcitationFreq_kHz < 18.000 THEN
        rAcousticExcitationFreq_kHz := 18.000;
    END_IF;
    bResonancePhaseLocked := (ABS(rPLL_PhaseError_deg) <= 3.5);
ELSE
    bResonancePhaseLocked := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Nodule Mass Production Extraction Calculation from Slurry Gamma Density *)
IF rNoduleSlurryDensity_kg_m3 > 1045.0 THEN
    (* Volumetric nodule fraction C_v = (rho_slurry - rho_water) / (rho_nodule - rho_water) *)
    rNoduleHarvestRate_tph := rVenturiSuctionFlow_m3ph * ((rNoduleSlurryDensity_kg_m3 - 1045.0) / (rNoduleDensity_kg_m3 - 1045.0)) * (rNoduleDensity_kg_m3 / 1000.0);
ELSE
    rNoduleHarvestRate_tph := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* ==================================================================================================
   STAGE 3: TERRAMECHANICS BEKKER-WONG TRACTION MODEL & REPAIR ENGINE
   ================================================================================================== *)
(* Estimated normal contact force on seabed from gravity, ballast thrusters, and umbilical tension *)
(* Crawler submerged dry-in-water weight W_sub = 120.0 kN *)
rSeabedContactForce_kN := 120.0 + rThruster_VentralDownforce_Port_kN + rThruster_VentralDownforce_Stbd_kN - (rVotedUmbilicalTension_kN * COS(rPitchAngle_deg * 0.0174533));
IF rSeabedContactForce_kN < 0.0 THEN
    rSeabedContactForce_kN := 0.0;
END_IF;
rCrawlerGroundPressure_kPa := rSeabedContactForce_kN / rTrackAreaTotal_m2;

(* Bekker-Wong Shear Stress Limit: tau_max = c + p * tan(phi) *)
(* Cohesion c derived directly from in-situ penetrometer undrained shear strength *)
rMaxSoilShearStress_kPa := rSedimentShearStrength_kPa + (rCrawlerGroundPressure_kPa * TAN(rPelagicInternalFriction_deg * 0.0174533));
rTractionLimitForce_kN := rTrackAreaTotal_m2 * rMaxSoilShearStress_kPa;

(* Mobilized track shear stress: tau(j) = tau_max * (1 - exp(-j / K)), where shear displacement j = i * L *)
IF rTractionSlipRatio_Port > 0.001 THEN
    rActualSoilShearStress_Port_kPa := rMaxSoilShearStress_kPa * (1.0 - EXP(-(rTractionSlipRatio_Port * rTrackLength_m) / rShearDeformationModulus_K_m));
ELSE
    rActualSoilShearStress_Port_kPa := 0.0;
END_IF;
IF rTractionSlipRatio_Stbd > 0.001 THEN
    rActualSoilShearStress_Stbd_kPa := rMaxSoilShearStress_kPa * (1.0 - EXP(-(rTractionSlipRatio_Stbd * rTrackLength_m) / rShearDeformationModulus_K_m));
ELSE
    rActualSoilShearStress_Stbd_kPa := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Detect Slip Exceedance & Sinkage Hazards *)
bTractionSlipAlarm := (rTractionSlipRatio_Port > 0.18) OR (rTractionSlipRatio_Stbd > 0.18);
bSinkageExceededAlarm := (rTrackPenetrationDepth_mm > 180.0);
IF bTractionSlipAlarm THEN
    dwAlarmTreeLowSeverity := dwAlarmTreeLowSeverity OR 16#00001000; (* Warning: Track Slip High *)
END_IF;
IF bSinkageExceededAlarm THEN
    dwAlarmTreeHighSeverity := dwAlarmTreeHighSeverity OR 16#00000004; (* Critical: Sinkage Exceeded *)
END_IF;

(* ==================================================================================================
   STAGE 4: STATE-SPACE KALMAN ESTIMATION & MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) SOLVER
   ================================================================================================== *)
(* Calculate Heading Error with Modular Wraparound (-180..+180 deg) *)
rHeadingError_deg := rHeadingTarget_deg - rYawHeading_deg;
IF rHeadingError_deg > 180.0 THEN
    rHeadingError_deg := rHeadingError_deg - 360.0;
ELSIF rHeadingError_deg < -180.0 THEN
    rHeadingError_deg := rHeadingError_deg + 360.0;
END_IF;

(* Calculate State Tracking Errors *)
rState_SurgeVelErr_mps := rSurgeVelocityTarget_mps - rVotedSurgeVel_mps;
rState_SwayVelErr_mps := 0.0 - rVotedSwayVel_mps; (* Maintain zero sway drift *)
rState_YawRateErr_radps := (rHeadingError_deg * 0.0174533 * 0.35) - (rYawRate_degps * 0.0174533);
rState_NormalForceErr_kN := rTargetSeabedDownforce_kN - rSeabedContactForce_kN;

(* Compute Quadratic Programming Gradient Vector: g = 2 * (matB^T * Q * error_vector) *)
rQP_Gradient_g1 := -2.0 * (matB_11 * rWeightQ_Surge * rState_SurgeVelErr_mps + matB_31 * rWeightQ_Yaw * rState_YawRateErr_radps);
rQP_Gradient_g2 := -2.0 * (matB_12 * rWeightQ_Surge * rState_SurgeVelErr_mps + matB_22 * rWeightQ_Sway * rState_SwayVelErr_mps + matB_32 * rWeightQ_Yaw * rState_YawRateErr_radps);
rQP_Gradient_g3 := -2.0 * (matB_13 * rWeightQ_Surge * rState_SurgeVelErr_mps + matB_23 * rWeightQ_Sway * rState_SwayVelErr_mps + matB_33 * rWeightQ_Yaw * rState_YawRateErr_radps);
rQP_Gradient_g4 := -2.0 * (matB_44 * rWeightQ_Downforce * rState_NormalForceErr_kN);

(* Hildreth's Dual Active-Set Quadratic Programming Solver for Constrained Thruster/Track Allocation *)
rQP_Lambda1 := 0.0;
rQP_Lambda2 := 0.0;
rQP_Lambda3 := 0.0;
rQP_Lambda4 := 0.0;
FOR iQPIterationCount := 1 TO c_iMaxQPIterations DO
    (* Projected Gauss-Seidel step for Lambda1 (Track Differential Torque) *)
    rQP_Lambda1 := (-(rQP_Gradient_g1 + rQP_Hessian_H12 * rQP_Lambda2 + rQP_Hessian_H13 * rQP_Lambda3 + rQP_Hessian_H14 * rQP_Lambda4)) / rQP_Hessian_H11;
    IF rQP_Lambda1 < -65.0 THEN rQP_Lambda1 := -65.0; ELSIF rQP_Lambda1 > 65.0 THEN rQP_Lambda1 := 65.0; END_IF;

    (* Projected Gauss-Seidel step for Lambda2 (Bow Thruster Allocation) *)
    rQP_Lambda2 := (-(rQP_Gradient_g2 + rQP_Hessian_H21 * rQP_Lambda1 + rQP_Hessian_H23 * rQP_Lambda3 + rQP_Hessian_H24 * rQP_Lambda4)) / rQP_Hessian_H22;
    IF rQP_Lambda2 < -35.0 THEN rQP_Lambda2 := -35.0; ELSIF rQP_Lambda2 > 35.0 THEN rQP_Lambda2 := 35.0; END_IF;

    (* Projected Gauss-Seidel step for Lambda3 (Aft Thruster Allocation) *)
    rQP_Lambda3 := (-(rQP_Gradient_g3 + rQP_Hessian_H31 * rQP_Lambda1 + rQP_Hessian_H32 * rQP_Lambda2 + rQP_Hessian_H34 * rQP_Lambda4)) / rQP_Hessian_H33;
    IF rQP_Lambda3 < -35.0 THEN rQP_Lambda3 := -35.0; ELSIF rQP_Lambda3 > 35.0 THEN rQP_Lambda3 := 35.0; END_IF;

    (* Projected Gauss-Seidel step for Lambda4 (Ventral Downforce Allocation) *)
    rQP_Lambda4 := (-(rQP_Gradient_g4 + rQP_Hessian_H41 * rQP_Lambda1 + rQP_Hessian_H42 * rQP_Lambda2 + rQP_Hessian_H43 * rQP_Lambda3)) / rQP_Hessian_H44;
    IF rQP_Lambda4 < -45.0 THEN rQP_Lambda4 := -45.0; ELSIF rQP_Lambda4 > 45.0 THEN rQP_Lambda4 := 45.0; END_IF;
END_FOR;

(* Dynamic Traction Vectoring: Surge Forward Thrust Split between Track and Thrusters *)
IF bTractionSlipAlarm THEN
    (* Slip Mitigation Mode: Unload tracks, shift surge thrust to horizontal thrusters *)
    rFilteredTrackTorquePort := rQP_Lambda1 * 0.45;
    rFilteredTrackTorqueStbd := -rQP_Lambda1 * 0.45;
    (* Bow and Aft thrusters provide direct surge vectoring to pull crawler out of slip *)
    rThruster_BowPort_kN := rQP_Lambda2 + 18.0; (* Forward surge bias *)
    rThruster_BowStbd_kN := -rQP_Lambda2 + 18.0;
    rThruster_AftPort_kN := rQP_Lambda3 + 18.0;
    rThruster_AftStbd_kN := -rQP_Lambda3 + 18.0;
    (* Reduce normal downforce to avoid sinking into sheared pelagic mud *)
    rFilteredDownforcePort := rQP_Lambda4 * 0.35;
    rFilteredDownforceStbd := rQP_Lambda4 * 0.35;
ELSE
    (* Nominal Coupled Traction Mode *)
    rFilteredTrackTorquePort := 35.0 * rSurgeVelocityTarget_mps + rQP_Lambda1;
    rFilteredTrackTorqueStbd := 35.0 * rSurgeVelocityTarget_mps - rQP_Lambda1;
    rThruster_BowPort_kN := rQP_Lambda2;
    rThruster_BowStbd_kN := -rQP_Lambda2;
    rThruster_AftPort_kN := rQP_Lambda3;
    rThruster_AftStbd_kN := -rQP_Lambda3;
    rFilteredDownforcePort := rQP_Lambda4 * 0.5;
    rFilteredDownforceStbd := rQP_Lambda4 * 0.5;
END_IF;

(* Pitch & Roll Slope Stabilization Feedforward *)
IF ABS(rPitchAngle_deg) > 4.0 THEN
    (* Counteract climbing/descending pitch moment on slopes up to 30 deg *)
    rFilteredDownforcePort := rFilteredDownforcePort + (rPitchAngle_deg * 0.65);
    rFilteredDownforceStbd := rFilteredDownforceStbd + (rPitchAngle_deg * 0.65);
END_IF;
IF ABS(rRollAngle_deg) > 3.0 THEN
    (* Counteract lateral roll tipping moment *)
    rFilteredDownforcePort := rFilteredDownforcePort - (rRollAngle_deg * 0.85);
    rFilteredDownforceStbd := rFilteredDownforceStbd + (rRollAngle_deg * 0.85);
END_IF;

(* ==================================================================================================
   STAGE 5: FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM) SUPERVISORY CONTROL (11 STAGES)
   ================================================================================================== *)
CASE iCurrentStateID OF
    0: (* STATE_COLD_BOOT_TMR_INIT: System Initialization & Sensor Health Validation *)
        rTrackTorqueRef_Port_kNm := 0.0;
        rTrackTorqueRef_Stbd_kNm := 0.0;
        rThruster_BowPort_kN := 0.0;
        rThruster_BowStbd_kN := 0.0;
        rThruster_AftPort_kN := 0.0;
        rThruster_AftStbd_kN := 0.0;
        rThruster_VentralDownforce_Port_kN := 0.0;
        rThruster_VentralDownforce_Stbd_kN := 0.0;
        rAcousticGeneratorPWM_Duty := 0.0;
        rFluidizingJetPressure_bar := 0.0;
        rVenturiSuctionFlow_m3ph := 0.0;
        bResonancePhaseLocked := FALSE;
        bSweepComplete := FALSE;

        IF bMasterEnable AND (dwAlarmTreeHighSeverity = 16#00000000) THEN
            iCurrentStateID := 10; (* Advance to Hydrostatic Equilibration *)
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE_HYDROSTATIC_COMPENSATION: 4000m Depth Verification & Barrier Pressure Trim *)
        tEquilibrationTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#3S);
        (* Verify hydrostatic pressure is within 360 to 450 bar at 4000m *)
        IF (rVotedDepthPressure_bar >= 360.0) AND (rVotedDepthPressure_bar <= 450.0) THEN
            wSystemStatusWord := wSystemStatusWord OR 16#0002; (* Equilibrated Bit1 *)
            IF tEquilibrationTimer.Q THEN
                tEquilibrationTimer(IN := FALSE);
                iCurrentStateID := 20; (* Advance to Seabed Touchdown *)
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            tEquilibrationTimer(IN := FALSE);
            dwAlarmTreeLowSeverity := dwAlarmTreeLowSeverity OR 16#00000080; (* Pressure not in depth window *)
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE_SEABED_TOUCHDOWN_TRIM: Controlled Soft Touchdown & Normal Force Ramp *)
        (* Apply progressive vertical downforce until contact force reaches 35 kN *)
        rThruster_VentralDownforce_Port_kN := 20.0;
        rThruster_VentralDownforce_Stbd_kN := 20.0;
        tTouchdownDampTimer(IN := (rSeabedContactForce_kN >= 30.0), PT := T#4S);
        IF tTouchdownDampTimer.Q THEN
            tTouchdownDampTimer(IN := FALSE);
            wSystemStatusWord := wSystemStatusWord OR 16#0004; (* Touchdown Bit2 *)
            iCurrentStateID := 30; (* Advance to Traction Baseline *)
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE_TRACTION_BASELINE_SURVEY: In-situ Sediment Shear Survey & Penetration Check *)
        rThruster_VentralDownforce_Port_kN := rFilteredDownforcePort;
        rThruster_VentralDownforce_Stbd_kN := rFilteredDownforceStbd;
        IF (rSedimentShearStrength_kPa >= 2.0) AND (rTrackPenetrationDepth_mm < 120.0) THEN
            IF bAcousticFluidizerEnable THEN
                iCurrentStateID := 40; (* Advance to Acoustic Sweep *)
            ELSE
                iCurrentStateID := 60; (* Skip acoustic bed if disabled, straight to crawl *)
            END_IF;
        ELSIF rTrackPenetrationDepth_mm >= 120.0 THEN
            (* Soft pelagic silt hazard: increase buoyant unloading *)
            rThruster_VentralDownforce_Port_kN := -15.0; (* Upward thrust to relieve seabed *)
            rThruster_VentralDownforce_Stbd_kN := -15.0;
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE_ACOUSTIC_IMPEDANCE_SWEEP: Automated Swept-Frequency Resonance Search (18..28.5 kHz) *)
        rAcousticGeneratorPWM_Duty := 18.0; (* Low power probe pulse *)
        tSweepTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#50MS);
        IF tSweepTimer.Q THEN
            tSweepTimer(IN := FALSE);
            rSweepCurrentFreq_kHz := rSweepCurrentFreq_kHz + 0.150; (* Step 150 Hz *)
            IF rAcousticImpedance_Ohm < rSweepMinImpedance_Ohm THEN
                rSweepMinImpedance_Ohm := rAcousticImpedance_Ohm;
                rSweepBestFreq_kHz := rSweepCurrentFreq_kHz;
            END_IF;
            IF rSweepCurrentFreq_kHz >= 28.500 THEN
                rAcousticExcitationFreq_kHz := rSweepBestFreq_kHz;
                rPLL_Integrator := rSweepBestFreq_kHz;
                bSweepComplete := TRUE;
                iCurrentStateID := 50; (* Advance to PLL Lock *)
            ELSE
                rAcousticExcitationFreq_kHz := rSweepCurrentFreq_kHz;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE_ACOUSTIC_PLL_LOCK: Closed-Loop Phase-Locked Bed Fluidization Engagement *)
        rAcousticGeneratorPWM_Duty := 65.0; (* Full nominal operating acoustic levitation power *)
        rFluidizingJetPressure_bar := 38.5; (* Energize fluidizing waterjet array *)
        rVenturiSuctionFlow_m3ph := rTargetSlurryDischarge_m3ph;
        tAcousticLockFilterTimer(IN := bResonancePhaseLocked, PT := T#1500MS);
        IF tAcousticLockFilterTimer.Q THEN
            tAcousticLockFilterTimer(IN := FALSE);
            wSystemStatusWord := wSystemStatusWord OR 16#0008; (* Resonance Locked Bit3 *)
            iCurrentStateID := 60; (* Advance to Active Harvest Advance *)
        END_IF;
        (* Emergency backflush check *)
        IF bDiffuserBackflushRequest THEN
            iCurrentStateID := 90;
        END_IF;

    60: (* STATE_HARVEST_COUPLED_ADVANCE: Coordinated Crawling, Vectoring, & Acoustic Extraction *)
        wSystemStatusWord := wSystemStatusWord OR 16#0010; (* Harvesting Active Bit4 *)
        (* Assign Output Setpoints from MPC & Traction Allocator *)
        rTrackTorqueRef_Port_kNm := rFilteredTrackTorquePort;
        rTrackTorqueRef_Stbd_kNm := rFilteredTrackTorqueStbd;
        rThruster_VentralDownforce_Port_kN := rFilteredDownforcePort;
        rThruster_VentralDownforce_Stbd_kN := rFilteredDownforceStbd;
        rFluidizingJetPressure_bar := 45.0;
        rAcousticGeneratorPWM_Duty := 80.0;
        rVenturiSuctionFlow_m3ph := rTargetSlurryDischarge_m3ph;

        (* Transitions out of Nominal Harvest *)
        IF bTractionSlipAlarm THEN
            iCurrentStateID := 70; (* Transition to Slip Mitigation *)
        ELSIF ABS(rPitchAngle_deg) > 12.0 THEN
            iCurrentStateID := 80; (* Transition to Scarp Traversal *)
        ELSIF bDiffuserBackflushRequest THEN
            iCurrentStateID := 90; (* Transition to Diffuser Purge *)
        ELSIF NOT bMasterEnable THEN
            iCurrentStateID := 100; (* Controlled Shutdown *)
        END_IF;

    70: (* STATE_SLIP_MITIGATION_ASSIST: Pelagic Soil Rupture Avoidance & Thruster Hand-off *)
        wSystemStatusWord := wSystemStatusWord OR 16#0020; (* Slip Mitigation Bit5 *)
        (* Cut track ground shear effort to prevent digging into ooze *)
        rTrackTorqueRef_Port_kNm := rFilteredTrackTorquePort * 0.3;
        rTrackTorqueRef_Stbd_kNm := rFilteredTrackTorqueStbd * 0.3;
        (* Thrusters take over 80% of vehicle forward surge *)
        rThruster_BowPort_kN := 28.0;
        rThruster_BowStbd_kN := 28.0;
        rThruster_AftPort_kN := 28.0;
        rThruster_AftStbd_kN := 28.0;
        (* Unload downforce to lighten crawler weight on weak clay *)
        rThruster_VentralDownforce_Port_kN := -10.0;
        rThruster_VentralDownforce_Stbd_kN := -10.0;

        tSlipRecoveryTimer(IN := NOT bTractionSlipAlarm, PT := T#3S);
        IF tSlipRecoveryTimer.Q THEN
            tSlipRecoveryTimer(IN := FALSE);
            wSystemStatusWord := wSystemStatusWord AND 16#FFDF; (* Clear Slip Mitigation Bit *)
            iCurrentStateID := 60; (* Return to coupled advance *)
        END_IF;

    80: (* STATE_SCARP_OBSTACLE_TRAVERSAL: Seafloor Ridge & Fault Scarp Climbing *)
        (* Full 6-DOF dynamic traction vectoring with tilt compensation *)
        rTrackTorqueRef_Port_kNm := rFilteredTrackTorquePort * 1.25;
        rTrackTorqueRef_Stbd_kNm := rFilteredTrackTorqueStbd * 1.25;
        rThruster_VentralDownforce_Port_kN := 35.0; (* Hard downforce clamp to prevent backward roll *)
        rThruster_VentralDownforce_Stbd_kN := 35.0;
        tScarpClimbTimer(IN := (ABS(rPitchAngle_deg) <= 6.0), PT := T#5S);
        IF tScarpClimbTimer.Q THEN
            tScarpClimbTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iCurrentStateID := 60; (* Return to nominal harvest *)
        END_IF;

    90: (* STATE_DIFFUSER_PURGE_BACKFLUSH: High-Pressure Reverse Eductor De-clogging *)
        rAcousticGeneratorPWM_Duty := 0.0;
        rFluidizingJetPressure_bar := 70.0; (* Full pressure reverse backflush *)
        rVenturiSuctionFlow_m3ph := -150.0; (* Reverse flow pulse *)
        rTrackTorqueRef_Port_kNm := 0.0;
        rTrackTorqueRef_Stbd_kNm := 0.0;
        tBackflushTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#4S);
        IF tBackflushTimer.Q THEN
            tBackflushTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iCurrentStateID := 50; (* Re-engage acoustic PLL *)
        END_IF;

    100: (* STATE_CONTROLLED_SHUTDOWN: Orderly Actuator Ramp-down & Standby *)
        rTrackTorqueRef_Port_kNm := 0.0;
        rTrackTorqueRef_Stbd_kNm := 0.0;
        rThruster_BowPort_kN := 0.0;
        rThruster_BowStbd_kN := 0.0;
        rThruster_AftPort_kN := 0.0;
        rThruster_AftStbd_kN := 0.0;
        rThruster_VentralDownforce_Port_kN := 0.0;
        rThruster_VentralDownforce_Stbd_kN := 0.0;
        rAcousticGeneratorPWM_Duty := 0.0;
        rFluidizingJetPressure_bar := 0.0;
        rVenturiSuctionFlow_m3ph := 0.0;
        bResonancePhaseLocked := FALSE;
        wSystemStatusWord := 16#0001; (* Ready Bit0 only *)
        IF bMasterEnable THEN
            iCurrentStateID := 10;
        END_IF;

    110: (* STATE_EMERGENCY_ASCENT_ABORT: SIL-3 Buoyant Ascent & Umbilical Jettison *)
        wSystemStatusWord := 16#0080; (* Emergency Ascent Bit7 *)
        (* Kill all floor-facing systems *)
        rTrackTorqueRef_Port_kNm := 0.0;
        rTrackTorqueRef_Stbd_kNm := 0.0;
        rAcousticGeneratorPWM_Duty := 0.0;
        rFluidizingJetPressure_bar := 0.0;
        rVenturiSuctionFlow_m3ph := 0.0;
        (* Max vertical upward thrust (negative downforce) to lift off seabed *)
        rThruster_VentralDownforce_Port_kN := -55.0;
        rThruster_VentralDownforce_Stbd_kN := -55.0;
        rThruster_BowPort_kN := 0.0;
        rThruster_BowStbd_kN := 0.0;
        rThruster_AftPort_kN := 0.0;
        rThruster_AftStbd_kN := 0.0;
        (* Latch until master hardware power cycle *)
        IF bResetAlarms AND NOT bEStopEmergencyAscent THEN
            bEmergencyAscentTriggered := FALSE;
            dwAlarmTreeHighSeverity := 16#00000000;
            iCurrentStateID := 0;
        END_IF;
END_CASE;

(* Export Current State ID *)
iCurrentStateID := iCurrentStateID;
